question: Should ClawHub adopt this signed sharded-feed producer contract now, including the production signing-key/trust-root rollout and the oversized-skills redirect, or wait until the matching OpenClaw consumer is ready to land with it?
rationale: The patch establishes a new public cross-repository distribution protocol and an operational signing boundary; tests cannot decide rollout timing, trust-root ownership, or compatibility policy for existing consumers.

options.title: Stage with the consumer
options.body: Keep this producer stack draft until the matching OpenClaw consumer and production signing-key rollout can be reviewed and proven together.

options.title: Approve producer-first rollout
options.body: Accept the compatibility and operational rollout risk, document the fallback contract, and land only after live producer evidence confirms the new endpoints.

recommendation.title: Stage with the consumer
recommendation.body: Keep this producer stack draft until the matching OpenClaw consumer and production signing-key rollout can be reviewed and proven together.

likelyOwner.reason: No reliable individual owner is identifiable from the supplied current-main history context; the decision belongs with the owners of the hosted-feed and OpenClaw consumer contract.
